[b]Log Entry 003  Who tis[/b]

[b][i]Unit: Sikirskian Armored Recon Group
Log by: Lieutenant Artem Zolnerovich
Time: 14:50 PM[/i][/b]

[i]"Patrolling the outskirts, we spotted movement about 600 meters north. Two figures, both on foot, moving cautiously. Civilian-looking, but we couldn't be sure. Ordered the driver to stop the APC. We exited, weapons ready but lowered. As they got closer, we saw they were wandererslocals, maybe nomads. They were dressed lightly, nothing suited for the cold, so they must have come from further inland. One of them had an old bolt-action rifle slung over his back, but no hostile movements."[/i]

[b]----[/b]

[b]Transcript of Encounter:[/b]

Lt. Zolnerovich: "Identify yourselves."
Wanderer 1: (Raises hands slightly, speaking in a language unknown to us.)
Corporal Mikhailov: "They're not hostile, sir."
Lt. Zolnerovich: "Lower your weapons, but stay alert."

The taller of the two, an older man, stepped forward. He pointed to the APC, then to our uniforms. He muttered something, then tapped his own chest and said what sounded like "Dunjala." His companion, a younger man, remained silent. We couldn't make sense of their language, but the older man eventually pointed to the horizon, mimicked walking, and made a drinking motion with his hand.

Corporal Mikhailov: "They might be asking for water."
Lt. Zolnerovich: "Give them some. But keep watching their movements."

We handed them a canteen, and the old man took a long sip before passing it to the younger one. After a brief exchange of nods, they turned and left. No sudden moves, no threats. Just a quiet departure. We noted their direction for future patrols.

[b][i]"First contact made. No hostility. But we dont know whats out there. We stay sharp."[/i][/b]
